title: cable crimping tournament training plan
author: Son of Carl
desc: run 3-5 times a week @ zone 2/easy not including programed days, any days you chose to rest should be active recover and no more then 2 times a week. deload every 3 weeks for 2-4 days @ <60% intensity. after week 9 add 5-15 lbs to bench and overhead press or just test your 1 rm and use that.
